skill.displayName: Yufluent Clawhub Publish Yufluentcn Comp Scrape

llm.summary: This is a cloud API client for competitor-analysis data, and its network and credential use are disclosed and aligned with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill analyzes user-provided CSV/API export data and optional listing text by sending it to a Yufluent/OpenClaw-style API endpoint, which matches its stated cloud-harness purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions disclose the required TOKENAPI_KEY and that analysis runs in the cloud, but users should understand that the competitor data and listing text they pass on the command line are transmitted to the configured API endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install metadata only requests pip installation of requests>=2.31.0 and a TOKENAPI_KEY environment variable; there is no installer-time execution, obfuscation, or bundled binary behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The optional TOKENAPI_BASE_URL override is documented and useful for local/dev deployments, but it means the bearer token and payload go to whatever endpoint the user configures.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, broad local indexing, or automatic mutation behavior was found; local file reads are limited to user-supplied CLI paths and output writes require an explicit -o/--output path.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending your competitor exports, product details, optional listing text, and TOKENAPI_KEY to the configured Yufluent/API endpoint. Keep TOKENAPI_BASE_URL unset or set only to a trusted endpoint you control, because the code does not enforce a host allowlist or HTTPS-only destination.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: The API helper posts payloads with the bearer token to a base URL derived from TOKENAPI_BASE_URL or caller input; this is a real configuration risk if the endpoint is set incorrectly, but it is not hidden and is consistent with a configurable cloud API client.
[SDI-2] expected: A record_outcome helper exists for POST /agent/outcomes, but the main run.py path does not call it, so this is not evidence of automatic secondary telemetry in normal skill execution.
[SQP-2] expected: The CLI reads explicitly supplied competitor data, product details, and optional listing text and sends them through run_skill; the cloud transmission is disclosed in the skill documentation and is central to the stated function.
